message: Magic Control Ultra v6.5: current Pro v2.6 features adapted to Ultra hardware.
notes: Ultra v6.5 brings the current Pro v2.6 Magic Control UI, Clock/Stopwatch and presets, MC Watch APIs, Peek, Force with Notes/Stopwatch and All, Notes, Calculator, and iPhone viewport/safe-area fixes. Ultra OLED wiring, battery monitoring, branding and the separate Ultra OTA channel are preserved. Existing Ultra v6.4 NVS and browser storage keys remain compatible; user settings and data are not reset.
